sourceExport: The owner's approved download, not in the repository: the zip (r1-rope001-zip/, left unopened) and the four JPG maps taken out of it (r1-rope001-maps/, git-ignored) under qa/memory/bord2/src/.
use: The texture of the rope (levels/steinagljufur/rope.js): a tube bent by the code, the texture repeated along it (the diagonal strands read as the rope's twist). Only the Color map is used: at the rope's size on the screen (about 7 cm thick) the Normal, Roughness and Displacement maps show nothing, so they are not shipped.
modifications: ffmpeg: shrunk from 1024 x 512 to 512 x 256 (lanczos) and written as WebP at quality 80. In the game: the code tints it slightly and repeats it along the tube.
